runtime_binding.binding_rule: Resolve preregistration_git_commit to the immutable commit that FIRST adds these exact MD/JSON bytes, not to a later diagnostic HEAD. Require that this commit exists in the pushed branch ancestry and fetch/verify it before execution. SHA-256 hashes are of raw UTF-8 file bytes, including final newline. Every run, shard, resumed attempt and report embeds the same commit and both file hashes; outputs also record their own code/config/input/output hashes.
runtime_binding.no_self_reference: A Git commit and a file cannot embed their own final cryptographic identity. This document freezes the binding contract; actual full commit and both file SHA-256 values are resolved after commit/push and inserted into every FUTURE run's metadata before any data/model diagnostic work. No Gate 1 run exists in this preregistration-only turn.

runtime_binding.amendments: Create a new preregistration version and new commit before new execution; retain old bytes, logs, failures and attempt IDs. Never edit this version in place after publication.

benchmark.name: Fundus
benchmark.diagnostic_resize_or_augmentation: none; use stored 384x384 without flips/translations/new crops

role_contract.train_labeled: Current-domain labeled data only: prototype fits and fixed supervised gradient batches. Historical prototypes are immutable outputs of their own stage fits.
role_contract.train_unlabeled: Current-domain images only: transport fit/holdout and fixed unlabeled gradient batches. label_h5_relpath and label_sha256 must be empty; no hidden GT lookup.
role_contract.val: Diagnostic evaluator only: held-out geometry, reliability, historical oracle and prototype-only accuracy. Never model/transport fit, threshold search, checkpoint selection or training API.
role_contract.test: No construction or reads in Gate 1. Existing Gate 0 test matrix files are immutable pre-existing artifacts, not Gate 1 GT sources.

benchmark.metadata_only_prework: Case IDs/roles/hashes were read from frozen CSV manifests; no HDF5 labels, feature tensors, checkpoint tensors or diagnostic metrics were read/computed for this registration. A name containing 'test' is not a role: only the frozen manifest role authorizes access.

feature_contract.architecture: LCRSeg UNet2D 16/32/64/128 with GroupNorm and pinned official JASCL stochastic 3x3 classifier
feature_contract.normalization: per-pixel z / ||z||_2; cosine clipped to [-1,1] only for roundoff
feature_contract.nonfinite_or_norm_le_eps: BLOCKED_NUMERICAL_FAILURE; do not drop panel-specific coordinates
feature_contract.feature_extraction_mode: eval + no_grad for all four panels; no model/buffer/GAS updates
feature_contract.original_constructor_rng_side_effect: Official module import and classifier constructor reset Torch RNG to 1024 (import also resets other generators). Import/construct/load first, then set per-diagnostic RNG seeds explicitly; record this upstream fact without changing accepted baseline initialization.

shared_sampling.hash_serialization: H(parts) = SHA256(UTF8(JSON compact separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=false, preserving list order)); S(parts) = int(first 8 hex chars of H(parts),16) & 0x7fffffff. Case-plan object hash uses insertion order train_labeled,train_unlabeled,val.
shared_sampling.pixel_uid: [case_id,class_id,y,x] at stored resolution; row-major coordinate index = 384*y+x
shared_sampling.geometry_rule: Within each seed/domain/role, enumerate non-ignore labeled class pixels. Set common quota=min(2048,minimum positive case-class pixel count); sample that many per nonempty case/class by ascending H(['geometry-pixel-v1',pixel_sampling_seed,role,case_id,class_id,y,x]), then pixel UID tie-break. Zero-count case/classes remain explicitly recorded, not replaced. Fit each class separately, equal case weight within class; outer summaries give each class equal weight. All four panels reuse ONE label-derived sample plan; no feature-dependent filtering or resampling.
shared_sampling.pixel_plan_materialization: Only after separate authorization: the diagnostic evaluator materializes label-dependent coordinate IDs once, stores per-case/class counts and coordinate/multiplicity SHA-256 BEFORE any panel extraction, and verifies identical hashes for all panels. A label-derived pixel hash is not claimed to exist at this preregistration-only stage.
shared_sampling.bootstrap_rule: Five case-level resamples with replacement from the original sorted train_labeled case list; exact case draws are in plans. Reuse original per-case pixels and quota; multiplicity weights reflect repeated cases. Same draw for every K/class/panel. Fit bootstrap prototypes on resampled labeled cases; compare to original fit by maximum-cosine Hungarian matching.
shared_sampling.bootstrap_draw_rule: bootstrap seed=S(['bootstrap-v1',seed,stage_index,replicate]); draw j uses int(H(['bootstrap-case-v1',bootstrap_seed,j]),16) modulo number of train_labeled cases

gate1a.input: Each checkpoint evaluated on its CURRENT domain only; fit=train_labeled, report geometry on val, occupancy on fit set, stability on training-case bootstrap fits

clustering.initializer: spherical K-means++: first sample by normalized case/pixel weight; subsequent samples proportional to weight * nearest cosine distance (not squared again); random draws from numpy.random.Generator(PCG64(kmeans_seed))
clustering.kmeans_seed: S(['kmeans-v1',seed,stage_index,class_id,K,replicate,restart]); original replicate=-1, bootstrap replicate=0..4, restart=0..4; panel ID is NEVER part of the seed
clustering.iteration: maximum cosine assignment (lowest cluster index on ties); normalized weighted mean update
clustering.K1: normalized case-weighted mean; zero resultant is a numerical hard stop
clustering.empty_cluster: reseed at largest weighted current quantization residual, pixel UID tie-break, without reusing an existing center; if no distinct sample remains, keep explicit inactive slot. Never secretly reduce K. Report active counts and dormant slots.
clustering.best_restart: minimum weighted training cosine quantization error; lowest restart index on ties
clustering.degenerate_candidate: Inactive/dormant K slots are reported explicitly; A1..A6 alone decide candidate admission. Nonfinite computations are global numerical blockers, not an opportunity to reduce K or resample.

metrics.Q_K: equal-case mean of min_k(1-clamp(z dot p_k,-1,1)), per class
metrics.cosine_distance_p95: weighted-ECDF 0.95 quantile of min cosine distance, equal total weight per case
metrics.R95: weighted-ECDF 0.95 quantile of sqrt(max(0,2-2*max_k cosine)); same samples/weights as Q_K
metrics.weighted_quantile: sort value then pixel UID; smallest value whose cumulative normalized weight is >= q
metrics.occupancy: case-weighted assignment mass / total class mass on original train_labeled samples; active means positive assignment mass
metrics.minimum_inter_prototype_separation: minimum pairwise unit-sphere Euclidean distance within class; additionally report angular distance; K1 separation=null by definition
metrics.bootstrap_stability: maximum-total-cosine Hungarian matching to original prototypes; median across all foreground unit/replicate/slot matches; unmatched/inactive slots contribute 0
metrics.boundary: per-class binary mask at 384x384; square 7x7 structuring element (Chebyshev radius 3), band=dilation(mask) minus erosion(mask), constant-false exterior; report sampled class pixels in band vs complement; ignore labels excluded; no training label changes
metrics.fg_macro: equal-weight mean of rim and cup, never pixel-weighted by background
metrics.reporting: all class/domain/seed values, nine foreground macro seed-domain rows, three domain summaries and background separately, per panel and K; no cross-panel aggregate

primary_gate_conditions.rule: number of B0-EMA foreground units with R95_K < R95_1
median over 9 seed-domain pairs of (mean_fg(R95_1)-mean_fg(R95_K))/mean_fg(R95_1)
fraction of active clusters with occupancy >= 0.05, pooled only across the 18 B0-EMA foreground units for this K
foreground bootstrap/Hungarian matched cosine median
number of domains with strictly lower mean-over-seeds foreground macro R95 than K1
all preceding admission statistics use foreground only; background-only improvement cannot pass

gate1a.selection: For each K in [2,3,5], evaluate the conjunction A1..A6 on B0-EMA's own 18 units. Select the smallest passing K. Controls neither select nor rescue K; their same statistics are descriptive only.

gate1b.K: selected only by B0-EMA Gate1A, or explicitly labeled K1 fallback
gate1b.integer_split: fit_count=floor(0.8*N); remaining holdout; 50/13 RIM_ONE_r3 and 32/9 Drishti_GS for every seed

coordinate_sampling.rule: rank all 384*384 integer coordinates by H(['transport-pixel-v1',seed,stage_index,case_id,y,x]) then (y,x); take first 2048 without replacement
coordinate_sampling.record: case IDs, split hash, coordinate IDs and SHA256 of ordered [case_id,y,x] lists; shared by T0/T1/T2, old/current encoders; no label access

T2.batch: full fit set, equal case weight

gate1b.historical_prototypes: Immutable historical-stage B0-EMA train_labeled geometry prototypes. No historical images in transport fit. At each transition, source-domain prototype angular error compares immediate previous-domain prototypes to current-space oracle; REFUGE two-step chain is reported separately.

oracle.construction: Use the historical domain's frozen validation case/pixel plan and original domain-index kmeans seeds from Gate1A, same selected K; current-stage B0 EMA encodes those historical validation images. Hungarian angular matching to source-derived prototypes. Oracle centers never enter transported history, pseudo-targets or any fitting.

metrics.heldout_feature_error: case-equal mean (1-cosine(T(z_old),z_current)) on held-out current cases
metrics.prototype_angular_error: mean Hungarian-matched arccos(clamped cosine) per foreground class; equal modes/classes/seeds/transitions
metrics.historical_prototype_accuracy: nearest maximum-cosine prototype class on historical validation pixels; case-equal overall accuracy plus foreground and class-wise accuracy, with same val pixels for identity/T1/T2
metrics.chain: T_stage2(T_stage1(p_REFUGE)) vs original p_REFUGE identity, both compared to stage2 current-space REFUGE val oracle; never overwrite source prototypes

primary_gate_conditions.rule: each transition mean-over-three-seeds heldout cosine error relative reduction versus T0
each transition seed count with strictly lower heldout error versus T0
relative reduction of foreground macro prototype angular error, equally averaged over 2 transitions x 3 seeds x 2 foreground classes, versus T0
relative prototype angular-error worsening for every seed/transition/foreground-class unit
historical prototype-only accuracy drop from T0 in every reported seed/source-domain/target-stage unit (including chain)
REFUGE chained foreground prototype angular error relative worsening versus direct identity, each seed and foreground class
all parameters, fit losses, feature/gradient values and singular values finite

gate1c.transport_source: B0 previous-stage EMA -> B0 current-stage EMA
gate1c.student_role: gradient receiver; gradient-conflict object; original R1 joint PAS mask retains its frozen student validity check, not a new student prototype/source selection
gate1c.K: Gate1A selected K; K1 only with explicit failure/fallback annotation
gate1c.transport: T2 only if Gate1B passes; otherwise identity history only, R4 unavailable
gate1c.probability_sampling: Primary probability target uses one frozen stochastic teacher draw (draw 0), preserving B0 stochastic objective. Same draw reused across R0..R4, normalization and PoE comparisons. Posterior-mean teacher target is a separately labeled control, never a replacement.

formulas.y_hat: argmax_c p_teacher(c), lowest class ID tie-break
formulas.a_cur: a_cur(c)=logsumexp_k(cos(z,p_current[c,k])/0.07)-log(number of valid current prototypes for class c)
formulas.a_hist: logsumexp of cos(z,p_history[d,c,k])/0.07 over valid historical prototypes - log(valid historical prototype count for class c); no raw logsumexp count advantage
formulas.s_hist: maximum cosine to valid same-predicted-class historical prototypes
formulas.p_fused: normalize_c(p_teacher * p_current^0.5 * p_history^(0.25*g_hist)); evaluate stably in log-space; offline target diagnostic only

gate1c.validity: Mask invalid/dormant prototypes before logmeanexp; do not replace them with zeros as valid centers. Missing current predicted-class prototype or no competitor => reliability 0, validity=false. No history, missing predicted-class history or no valid historical competitor => g_hist=0 and r_hist=r_cur; PoE history factor=1. At stage0 R3=R2 and, if otherwise available, R4=R2. Missing required foreground class coverage is a sampling blocker, not a smaller denominator.
gate1c.detach: Teacher probability/feature, all prototypes, transport outputs/oracles, validity masks, all reliability weights and PoE targets are detached. Teacher/prototype/oracle grads must remain None.

candidates.R1: original joint hard PAS validity: frozen checkpoint prototypes key 'prototypes', confidence >0.7 AND prototype similarity >0.7 separately for student and teacher, then joint AND. Do not substitute the new EMA multi-prototype bank into R1.
candidates.R4: current + admitted T2-history r_hist; unavailable if Gate1B fails

evaluation.role: val only, all non-ignore pixels; no train/val mixing
evaluation.class_metrics: teacher-predicted class strata for weight-only risk/precision/coverage, foreground macro equal rim/cup; true-label composition and true-class recalls also reported, not used to choose prototypes
evaluation.case_balance: each case has equal total mass within a reported stratum
evaluation.ranking: descending detached reliability; ties ordered by H(['reliability-tie-v1',seed,stage_index,case_id,y,x]); no GT tie-break
evaluation.eligible: strictly positive weight only; R1 eligible pixels are exactly its joint PAS mask
evaluation.coverage_definition: accepted case-balanced mass / full valid case-balanced mass within stratum
evaluation.common_coverage: For a candidate versus R1 within the same seed/domain/class, use [0,min(max_positive_coverage_R1,max_positive_coverage_candidate)]; report the upper bound. Do not extrapolate beyond positive support. Fixed coverage points outside support are null with reason.
evaluation.AURC: case-weighted risk=1-precision integrated as a right-continuous ranked step curve from 0 to common coverage upper bound, divided by that bound; additionally report each candidate full available-support AURC and standard risk-coverage curve
evaluation.matched_precision: equal mean precision difference at prelisted coverage points supported by BOTH candidate and R1 in every required foreground unit; report the exact shared point set; no post-result best coverage selection
evaluation.foreground_units: 18 B0 seed/domain/predicted-foreground-class units; compute class-wise AURC and precision, then equally average units for macro metrics
evaluation.unit_improvement: AURC strictly lower than R1 OR shared-point mean precision strictly higher than R1, with both raw deltas reported
evaluation.coverage_guard: within each seed/domain, at matched GLOBAL operating coverage min(0.50,max_positive_global_coverage_R1,max_positive_global_coverage_candidate), measure each foreground predicted-class retained fraction; no class may fall below 0.8 times R1. Operating point depends only on scores/support, not GT.
evaluation.unavailable_primary_comparison: Do not impute/omit a required unit or search new coverage points. Empty positive support or no shared prelisted point is reported; unsupported precision branch cannot pass. Undefined required AURC/gradient comparison cannot satisfy admission.
evaluation.ECE: 15 equal-width [0,1] bins; equal-case weights; empty bins reported explicitly
evaluation.Brier: sum over 3 classes of squared probability error, equal-case mean
evaluation.reliability_bins: 15 equal-width [0,1] bins, report weighted accuracy/counts; teacher-confidence ECE separate from reliability calibration
evaluation.poe: Teacher target and PoE fused target predictions/metrics reported separately, on paired samples and coverage; no automatic PoE adoption

primary_gate_conditions.rule: foreground macro AURC relative reduction >=0.10 OR shared-point matched-coverage precision increase >=0.01 versus R1
foreground units improving versus R1
relative retained-coverage decrease for ANY foreground class at registered matched global operating point
negative global gradient-cosine batch fraction relative reduction versus R1 over same 72 pairs
global gradient cosine median increase over same 72 pairs versus R1
each domain median gradient cosine worsening versus R1 (24 pairs/domain)
teacher/prototype/transport oracle receive no gradients
hidden-GT training usage=none and test GT usage=none

gate1c.decision_order: Primary history-aware target is R4 if transport admitted, otherwise R3 for explanatory fallback. Test pixel-normalized weight-only first; use class-balanced weight-only only if it independently satisfies ALL the same conditions and pixel-normalized does not. R0/R2 and identity-history comparisons remain separately reported; do not silently replace failed primary history-aware reliability with a favorable current-only/control target.
gate1c.normalization_comparison_reference: All C4..C6 admission deltas use the original pixel-normalized R1 on the identical 72 pairs, including when the candidate is class-balanced. Class-balanced R1 is an additional reported normalization control, not a replacement admission reference.
gate1c.poe_admission: PoE is a separate offline candidate, tested with the same C1..C8 conditions and same fixed batches/support rules (stratify PoE by its own predicted class and report target-class changes). It never rescues failed weight-only core reliability or becomes default automatically; any proposed PoE method needs separate review.
gate1c.if_weight_only_passes_but_poe_fails: retain weight-only as a future proposal only
gate1c.if_class_balanced_passes_but_pixel_norma: propose class-balanced normalization, with both results disclosed; no method registration in Gate1

gradient_diagnostic.sampling: sampler_seed=20260830+100*seed+stage_index; independently hash-order current labeled/unlabeled case IDs by H(['grad-order-v1',sampler_seed,role,cycle,case_id]); concatenate cycles until 16 IDs, take consecutive pairs. Repeats across pairs when pool exhausted are intentional and predeclared. No replacement based on gradients, targets or GT.
gradient_diagnostic.input_preprocessing: stored RGB /255, no diagnostic augmentation; labeled CE and unlabeled probability objectives use these same frozen images across candidates; this is a probe, not a baseline trajectory rerun
gradient_diagnostic.forward_order: load unchanged B0 checkpoint including complete GAS and classifier; seed per forward; primary unlabeled student stochastic draw, primary teacher draw 0 under no_grad, labeled student stochastic draw; retain/cache common values for all candidate losses; no GAS update from diagnostic g_sup

formulas.supervised: L_sup=CrossEntropy(student stochastic logits,labeled GT,ignore_index=255), mean over valid labeled pixels
formulas.class_balanced: mean over active teacher-predicted classes c of sum_{i:y_hat=c} r_i*loss_i/(sum_{i:y_hat=c}r_i+1e-12); active iff positive total weight
formulas.zero_weight: return graph-connected p_student.sum()*0.0, not a detached scalar
formulas.gradients: g_sup=grad(L_sup), g_u=grad(L_u), g_u_cb=grad(L_u_cb), autograd.grad only, no backward optimizer mutation
formulas.global_cosine: dot(g_sup,g_u)/(||g_sup||_2*||g_u||_2); zero-norm cosine is undefined/null with explicit zero-gradient flag, never fabricated 0 or silently omitted
formulas.zero_norm_admission: any required primary g_sup/g_u comparison with zero norm makes that candidate's gradient admission unsatisfied; finite graph-connected zero is not a NaN or protocol violation; report all 72 rows

gradient_diagnostic.inactive_parameters: Explicitly inventory official sigma/grad_update and any other registered-but-unused parameters. Require None gradient where expected; no silent drop of an active parameter. Six blocks must exactly partition all active gradient parameters, with inactive inventory recorded separately.
statistics: background/rim/cup component gradient norms and non-additive vector decomposition
gradient_diagnostic.scalar_quantiles: unweighted linearly interpolated sample quantiles; all 72 fixed pairs equally weighted; per-domain 24 pairs

stochasticity.seeds: explicit teacher_draw_seeds in each batch row
stochasticity.posterior_mean_teacher: independent control only; stochastic_classifier=false; no silent replacement of B0

gradient_diagnostic.frozen_parameters_buffers_and_gas: bitwise equal before/after every diagnostic unit

theory.primary_sources: B0-EMA feature/prototypes and admitted transport, or explicitly labeled K1/identity fallback; never switch to control panel

quantities.R_d_c_K: equal-case mean and weighted p95 of nearest class-prototype Euclidean distances
quantities.delta_d_c: p95 Hungarian-matched Euclidean distance of bootstrap prototypes to original prototypes; also mean and all replicate values
quantities.E_d_t: p95 historical prototype Euclidean error versus current-space diagnostic oracle, class-wise and foreground macro; report current holdout paired error separately
quantities.Delta_d: minimum Euclidean separation between valid modes belonging to different classes; foreground-only separation additionally reported
quantities.margin_violation_rate: equal-case fraction of diagnostic validation pixels where nearest-own-class distance + delta_d_c + E_d_t >= Delta_d/2
quantities.eta_c: sum of detached reliability weights on incorrect pseudo-labels / total detached reliability weight for predicted class c, diagnostic val evaluator only

theory.oracle_consumption: diagnostic_evaluator_only; never feeds fitting, threshold selection or training
theory.claim_limit: Empirical direction checks of assumptions only, not proof of a theorem and not an extra admission gate.

numerical_and_protocol_policy.aggregation: No rounding before comparisons; strict improvement is < for errors and > for precision. Equality passes only inclusive stated thresholds. No tolerance relaxation near a gate.
numerical_and_protocol_policy.relative_reduction: (reference-candidate)/reference for positive reference. If reference=0, positive improvement cannot be claimed; candidate=0 yields 0 reduction, candidate>0 fails improvement and any bounded-relative-worsening guard. Do not introduce epsilon to manufacture a passing percent.
numerical_and_protocol_policy.reference_negative_fraction_zero: If R1 already has zero negative-gradient fraction, required relative reduction is not demonstrable; candidate=0 records reduction 0 and cannot satisfy C4's 20% improvement. No post-result 'nonworsening' substitution.
allowed_structural_nulls: zero-norm gradient cosine with explicit candidate failure
numerical_and_protocol_policy.unexpected_missing_values: fail closed; never silently drop units
numerical_and_protocol_policy.numerical_failure: Any panel/primary diagnostic nonfinite feature, prototype, probability, loss, gradient, parameter or singular value => BLOCKED_NUMERICAL_FAILURE. No panel-specific sample deletion/retry with another seed.
numerical_and_protocol_policy.protocol_failure: Any provenance/hash/leakage/sampling mismatch in ANY panel => BLOCKED_PROTOCOL_OR_LEAKAGE for the entire Gate1, regardless of primary performance.
numerical_and_protocol_policy.immutable_model_check: full parameter/buffer/classifier/GAS hashes before and after; model_optimizer_steps=0 cannot replace the hash checks
numerical_and_protocol_policy.warn_policy: Preserve all existing upstream warnings and first failures with exact commands/env. Unsupported-kernel determinism warnings disclosed; no tolerance changes or hidden reruns.

precedence: Any protocol/leakage/provenance/sampling failure in any panel blocks entire Gate1; preserve all errors.
Otherwise any unexpected numerical failure in any panel blocks entire Gate1.
No final admission verdict while any required panel/component output is missing.
If Gate1A K>1, Gate1B T2 and primary history-aware weight-only reliability all pass, PASS_CORE_ADMISSION.
If Gate1A fails but K1 T2 and history-aware weight-only reliability pass, PASS_REDUCED_K1; Gate1A itself remains FAIL_MULTI_MODALITY_NOT_SUPPORTED and multi-prototype naming is forbidden.
Otherwise retain all component failures; select overall FAIL_MULTI_MODALITY_NOT_SUPPORTED if A failed, else FAIL_TRANSPORT_NOT_SUPPORTED if B failed, else FAIL_RELIABILITY_NOT_SUPPORTED.
status_machine.current_snapshot: NOT_RUN_PREREGISTRATION_ONLY is a publication lifecycle marker, NOT a Gate1 final overall_status.
status_machine.end_action: STOP_FOR_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW; all method flags remain false even on admission PASS; no model training or Gate2 automatically.

delivery_and_stop.approved_before_results_conventions: Operational definitions added here (deterministic hash sampling, exact case batches, clustering defaults, aggregation/ties, support/zero rules and transport optimizer defaults) are frozen before any mechanism result; they are not claimed as historical paper facts or prior measured findings.
